videos.title: Doctor Who
videos.description: The Doctor has a new companion, a bride who is somewhat late for her wedding. As the Tardis races to get her to the church on time, the mysterious Empress joins the chase, and it soon emerges that the bride is the key to an ancient alien plan to destroy the Earth.

videos.title: Peter Pan Goes Wrong
videos.description: The Cornley Polytechnic Drama Society, an amateur dramatics group, recreate the JM Barrie classic. Can they pull it off? Filmed in front of a live audience, watch as Peter Pan flies through the air, Captain Hook and his pirates set adrift in the lagoon, and Tinkerbell is due to light up the stage in a stunning electrical costume.

videos.title: Miranda
videos.description: Gary is preparing for the grand re-opening of the restaurant. Putting on his best chef whites, he has never looked so attractive to Miranda. Will Stevie persuade her to say what she feels, or will Penny get in the way as she excitedly stalks her poster boy, Raymond Blanc?

videos.title: Miranda
videos.description: A fed-up Miranda makes a big life decision: she's going travelling. She has packed her bags and is leaving, this time for good. Stevie is devastated, and Penny is too wrapped up in renewing her wedding vows to notice. Only Gary can stop her going, but how does he really feel?

videos.title: Gavin & Stacey
videos.description: After his initial angry reaction to Stacey's news, Uncle Bryn agrees to drive everyone to Essex to meet the Shipmans. Pam has laid on a cracking spread and the party goes with a bang, but then Gavin and Stacey make an announcement that throws all the bonhomie out the window.

videos.title: Gavin & Stacey
videos.description: The Shipmans drive down to Wales for the wedding fair, and after an eventful trip to church to hear the banns being read, Nessa confides in Stacey her big secret.

videos.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
videos.description: Almost 1,000 applied. Thirty battled it out in the regional heats. And now, six finalists take to the stage in their bid to win over the judges and be crowned BBC New Comedian 2025.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: After the attack on his best friends and threats against his little sister, Mobeen is armed, dangerous and set for revenge. But can he solve his problems without any bloodshed?

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen is trying to do a good deed by helping out at the local food bank. But juggling this with strict orders from Uncle Khan could leave him with a debt that's impossible to pay.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen is attending the funeral of his former teacher. But when a drug deal goes wrong at the church, he has bigger things to worry about.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: With a hit out on Officer Harper, Mobeen steps in to try and save his life, whilst Eight and Nate attempt to stall Harper's assassin.

videos.title: Man Like Mobeen
videos.description: Mobeen and the gang must get out of Small Heath, but can he tie up loose ends and guarantee his sister's safety before the police or Khan's gang take him down?

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Jonny gets a job and a sexy offer he can't refuse, Gaz and Donna are up all night for the wrong reasons, and David shows Louise a new way to cope with growing old.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Louise finally agrees to sex with David and finds him to be insatiable, but thankfully for her, his level of performance is short-lived.

videos.title: Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps
videos.description: Janet has decided that the most important thing about getting married is the presents she'll receive, so makes a list.

videos.title: Juice
videos.description: Now that Jamma is in a committed relationship, everyone starts to fancy him. But instead of focusing on his own issues, he ends up playing therapist to his mum and dad. At work, he attempts to bond with Isaac in order to land the next big project.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: Max faces a decision as the Carters look towards the future. Suki's attempt to protect her family has unexpected consequences. Oscar receives some surprising encouragement.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: A decision threatens to derail what Suki and Eve have been fighting for. Celebrations take an unexpected turn when some surprising news sends emotions running high. Gina and Penny search for answers.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: Suki's actions continue to have consequences. Penny finds herself caught up in a misunderstanding that quickly spirals. Oscar makes a bold declaration in the Vic.

videos.title: EastEnders
videos.description: Eve strikes up an unexpected bond. Vinny and Penny are forced to consider their future. Jasmine's spirits are lifted.

videos.title: Stacey & Joe
videos.description: A tense camping trip, a lost wedding ring and goat yoga, all whilst a possible move from Pickle Cottage takes a big step forward.

videos.title: Strike
videos.description: Edie Ledwell, the co-creator of a cult TV cartoon, 'The Ink Black Heart', is being harassed by an online figure, Anomie. She asks Robin to uncover Anomie's true identity.

videos.title: Strike
videos.description: Robin, Strike and Barclay all take risks to further the investigation now that they think Anomie probably killed Edie Ledwell. Strike receives an unexpected and unwelcome visitor.

videos.title: Fall
videos.description: When they're stranded with no way down, Becky and Hunter's adrenaline-packed 2,000 feet climb to the top of a remote tower soon turns into a fight for survival.

videos.title: Stacey Dooley
videos.description: Stacey heads to Bedfordshire to the private site where 23-year-old Chantelle lives with her husband, Swayley. Chantelle prides herself in keeping with the old Gypsy values her granny Rita taught her and sharing them on social media.

videos.title: Kidnapped by My Mum
videos.description: At 11 years old, Alex Batty vanished on what was supposed to be a short family holiday with his mother and grandfather. An international missing persons investigation was launched, but years passed without a trace. Then, six years later, a teenager appeared on the side of a road in the French Pyrenees and told a passing driver that he'd been kidnapped. Alex, now aged 20, is ready to tell the full story about his abduction and his life on the run.

videos.title: The Catch-Up
videos.description: A round-up of the day's news.

videos.title: Horrible Histories
videos.description: Featuring some of history's biggest love rats. King Henry VIII goes on a TV dating show, femme fatale Queen Cleopatra looks for love online, Emperor Nero stars in his own romance movie, and Victoria and Albert sing about love at first sight.

videos.title: Horrible Histories
videos.description: Young William, Duke of Normandy, quarrels with Harold Godwinson about who should be King of England, before bashing the English and taking the crown at the famous Battle of Hastings in 1066! Meanwhile across the world, discover Chinese technology light years ahead of the dunderheaded Normans.

videos.title: Top Gear
videos.description: Jeremy asks why there aren't more three-wheeled cars in the world. James attempts to drive a Toyota Hilux up an active volcano in Iceland, and The Stig rips up the track in the new Bentley Continental Supersports.

videos.title: Top Gear
videos.description: The boys attempt to find a trio of cars which are equally at home on the racetrack as they are at transporting a family to the shops, all for a budget of £5,000. Plus, James makes a rare visit to the "Top Gear" track to test a pair of Porsches, the 911 Sport Classic and Boxster Spyder, while Alastair Campbell is the star in the all new Reasonably Priced Car.

videos.title: Silent Witness
videos.description: Nikki revisits an emotive case from the past when a girl she proved innocent of murder is herself murdered.

videos.title: Silent Witness
videos.description: Nikki grows increasingly worried that a mistake she made on a case four years ago may have contributed to the murder of a young woman.

videos.title: Get Out
videos.description: Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway upstate with her parents, Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behaviour as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

videos.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
videos.description: Kate Sharp, Rachel Baker, Lucas Jones Ho, Patrick Conlan and Ravi Saini are among the 30 comics picked from almost a thousand applicants to the BBC New Comedy Awards. Tonight, they compete for a place in the grand final at Birmingham Town Hall, where one act will be named BBC New Comedian 2026. Award-winning comedian Josh Pugh hosts. Each comic performs one set for the judges: stand-up and former winner Dan Tiernan, actor and improv comic Kiell Smith-Bynoe and head judge Amy Gledhill.

videos.title: BBC New Comedy Awards
videos.description: The BBC's comedy talent search is back. More than a thousand comics applied, and just 30 made it through to the heats. This is the last of six, and five more acts are competing for the last place in this year's grand final. The Box at Fargo Village, Coventry, will once again be converted into the BBC's own New Comedy Club. Mancunian ray of sunshine Josh Jones is our host for the night.

videos.title: Juice
videos.description: Guy is eager to meet Jamma's parents, but Jamma faces a challenge in getting his mum to agree to the introduction. He gets theatrical in an attempt to uncover the truth behind Farida's actions.
